notes: One live DSH TUI session completes a text-only turn, remains ready for at least 20 seconds while its PID stays bound, then completes a second text-only turn on the same session. The recording daemon must use IRRLICHT_READY_SESSION_TTL=15s, so the ready dwell crosses the actual reap cutoff. The idle window rejects transcript activity, removal, and state changes; this prevents a background transcript refresh from masking a broken PID-liveness hold. The single-birth shape is provisional until record.

text: The post-marker DSH session appears in ready after TUI launch
The live DSH process binds to the session before the idle test
The first prompt moves the session to working
The first turn completes and the session returns to ready
The live session remains visible and ready beyond the configured readyTTL
The second prompt resumes working on the same session after the long idle
The second turn completes and the same session returns to ready
